problems.title: Average of Array
problems.feedback: Correct implementation with proper traversal. However, integer division is used which may lead to loss of precision. In interviews, consider returning double for accurate average.

problems.title: Count Positive, Negative and Zero
problems.feedback: Logic is correct and clean. However, method design is poor as it returns a dummy value and handles printing internally. In interviews, separate logic and output, and return meaningful data.

problems.title: Reverse String
problems.feedback: Functionally correct, but inefficient due to string concatenation inside loop leading to O(n^2) complexity. In interviews, use StringBuilder for optimal performance.

problems.title: Move Zeros to End
problems.feedback: Excellent implementation using two-pointer approach. Optimal O(n) solution and maintains relative order. This is a standard placement-level pattern.

problems.title: Find Length of String Without length()
problems.feedback: Uses exception handling to control loop termination, which is a bad practice. Exceptions should not be used for normal logic. Interviewers expect a loop-based or traversal approach.

problems.title: Check Equal Arrays
problems.feedback: Correct comparison logic. However, missing edge case check for different array lengths. Always validate sizes before element comparison.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.feedback: Correct and efficient implementation using sum formula. Optimal O(n). Good understanding of problem. Can be further optimized using XOR approach for interview depth.
